card.name: Dosing interval spacing before the number
card.fires_on: The space or word right after "every" or "intervals of" where an hours or weeks number comes next, and the word "interval" in "end of the dosing interval".

modes.label: Gap before interval number
modes.description: The blank position after "every" or "intervals of (less than)" just before a number of hours or weeks.
modes.example: Give first dose on awakening; additional doses (1 or 2) at intervals of<< >>4 to 6 hours.

modes.label: End of dosing interval
modes.description: The word "interval" in text about a drug effect fading toward the end of the dosing interval.
modes.example: the antihypertensive effect may diminish toward the end of the dosing<< interval>>.

card.writes: It pushes toward words about lasting, sustaining and endurance, which fit how long a dose's effect holds.
card.plain: It fires where the text is about to say how many hours or weeks apart doses are given, or when a dose wears off.
